lessons.title: Lesson 1: Vocabulary & Pronunciation /ə/ and /ɜː/
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Vocabulary & Pronunciation /ə/ and /ɜː/.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: Verbs expressing preferences such as like, love, enjoy, fancy, adore, hate, dislike are followed by a gerund (verb + -ing).
concepts.example: I enjoy collecting stamps. / She hates playing computer games all day.
concepts.essence: The gerund acts as a noun representing the activity itself.

rules.statement: Present Simple Tense for habitual actions
rules.meaning: Use Present Simple to describe habits, routines, or general truths. Add -s/-es for third-person singular subjects (He/She/It).
rules.example: He goes swimming twice a week. / The sun rises in the east.
rules.essence: Adverbs of frequency (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) normally precede the main verb.

workedExamples.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb: 'My brother (not like) __________ (read) __________ comics.'
steps: Step 1: The subject 'My brother' is third-person singular, so the negative auxiliary is 'does not' (doesn't).
Step 2: The verb 'like' remains in base form: doesn't like.
Step 3: After 'like', the verb 'read' takes the -ing form: reading.
workedExamples.answer: My brother doesn't like reading comics.

commonMistakes.mistake: Writing 'She like' instead of 'She likes' with third-person singular subjects.
commonMistakes.why: In Present Simple, always remember to add -s or -es to the verb when the subject is He, She, It, or a singular noun.
